Fill out the application form with all required details accurately.

Attach self-attested photocopies of mark sheets and certificates in support of educational qualifications, degree/post-graduation/diploma/professional qualification certificates, experience certificates specifying the nature and period of experience, any other required certificate, and a recent passport-size photograph.
Submit a separate application form if applying for more than one post.
Place the application in a sealed cover.
Superscribe the envelope as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF _______".
Address and send the application to: The District Health Society, O/o the Deputy Commissioner, Lucknow, Mayabunder - 744 204, North & Middle Andaman.
Ensure the application reaches on or before 23rd October, 2026 up to 05:00 P.M.
important_instructions: Applications received after the prescribed date and time shall not be accepted and shall be liable to be rejected. Mode of application is offline as per the prescribed application format. A candidate wishing to apply for more than one post shall submit a separate application form for each post. Eligible candidates shall be required to attend the walk-in interview on the date and time to be notified subsequently along with all original certificates/documents and one set of self-attested photocopies. Incomplete or defective applications, applications without the requisite certificates/documents, or applications without the candidate's photograph shall be summarily rejected. No individual call letters shall be issued to the candidates; names of eligible candidates will be displayed on the Notice Board of the District Health Society, North & Middle Andaman, O/o the Deputy Commissioner, Lucknow, Mayabunder, and published in The Daily Telegram and web portals. No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates appearing for the interview. No accommodation facility shall be provided to candidates appearing for the interview. The engagement is made purely on a contract basis for a period of 11 months from the date of signing of the contract.

rows.qualification_required: Essential Qualification: 1. Candidates must have passed All India Senior School Certificate Examination (10+2) or equivalent from a recognised board/institution. 2. B.Sc. Nursing from a recognized university/institution/board OR Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery plus One year Diploma in Public Health Nursing from a recognized university/institution / board. 3. The candidate must be registered with the Nursing Council, and their registration must be valid and active. Desirable Qualification: 1. Diploma in computer course. 2. Experience (if any) in the relevant field.

Essential Qualification: 1. XII Passed from a recognized Board / Institution. 2. Must have passed ANM certificate course with valid ANM training Certificate from a recognized institution. 3. The candidate must be registered with the Nursing Council, and their registration must be valid and active. Desirable Qualification: 1. Experience (if any) in the relevant field.

Essential Qualification: 1. Degree in pharmacy (or) Diploma in Pharmacy from a recognized University / Institution. 2. Registration with Pharmacy Council under Section-12 of Pharmacy Act, 1948. Desirable Qualification: 1. Experience (if any) in the relevant field.

Essential Qualification: 1. XII Passed with Science subjects from a recognized Board / Institution. 2. Degree / Diploma in Homoeopathic Pharmacy or its equivalent with the essential subjects like Homoeopathic Pharmacy, Homoeopathic Materia Medica and Organon of Medicine from a recognized Institute or Certificate Course in Homoeopathic Pharmacy from a recognised Institution with a minimum of 03 to 05 years experience of dispensing Homoeo Medicine in a recognised Hospital or Dispensary. Desirable Qualification: 1. Experience in dispensing Homoeo Medicine.

faq.question: Q1. What is the DHS North & Middle Andaman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the District Health Society, North & Middle Andaman, to fill 7 vacant posts including Public Health Nurse, ANM, and Pharmacist on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 7 vacancies are available across Public Health Nurse (4), Additional Auxiliary Nurse Midwife (1), Pharmacist Allopathy RBSK (1), and Pharmacist Homeopathy (1) posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DHS North & Middle Andaman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 23rd October, 2026 up to 05:00 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Public Health Nurse (PHN)?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10+2 and possess a B.Sc. Nursing degree OR a Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery plus a one-year Diploma in Public Health Nursing, with valid Nursing Council registration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DHS North & Middle Andaman posts?
faq.answer: The upper and lower age limits are not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply offline by filling out the prescribed application format, attaching self-attested documents, and sending it in a sealed envelope superscribed with the post name to the District Health Society office in Mayabunder.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is based on educational merit, relevant work experience, and a personal interview board.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly salary offered?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is ₹21,632/- for Public Health Nurse and Pharmacist posts, and ₹18,434/- for the Additional Auxiliary Nurse Midwife post.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, but candidates wishing to apply for more than one post must submit a separate application form for each post.
